verdict.rationale: Adyen's Management API is documented to let you order terminals/readers via API instead of the Customer Area (adyen-pos-docs-11), which covers reader registration, but there is no evidence pack mention of an API endpoint or workflow for creating/provisioning a 'location' entity itself, so end-to-end location+reader provisioning isn't demonstrated. missing for 10: explicit API documentation for creating a location/store object, confirmation that reader ordering can be linked to a newly created location in one agentic flow, and independent/hands-on proof of this end-to-end flow working.
